bounds.basis: Full documented context bound; Luna-specific image sizing is not documented. Highest Standard long-context cache-write/output rates plus 10% regional margin.

budget_note: 96 fixed planned calls, at most $1 total. Confirmed usage releases reservation headroom conservatively. Unresolved calls retain the full bound and are never retried; execution stops on an unresolved call or insufficient headroom.

quality_scores.scope: Judge diagnostics only; no trained-model baseline or $50 improvement claim. No image-order reversal probe is included.
